sequenceNote: 1) Refresh Core/Content/Util map for client+server, 2) harden hydrology-driven worldgen (caves/rivers/lakes) and world-map control parity, 3) validate protobuf bindings, 4) ship docs/builds.

server.name: world-map-control-signature
server.notes: Keep control profile hash/signature aligned with world + proto content; reuse terrain masks in cache-aware map streaming.

server.name: protocol-registry-validation
server.notes: Verify generated EnhancedMinecraft DTOs and handler bindings at startup; surface missing packet coverage and stale descriptors.

client.name: world-map-preview-parity
client.notes: Unity preview mirrors server hydrology/cave tuning with seam-safe smoothing; reloads profile hashes when JSON drifts.

client.name: protocol-client-bindings
client.notes: Ensure client protobuf DTO references match SharedProtocol registry; guard against stale generated assemblies.

server.name: hydrology-coherent-caves
server.notes: Hydrology-driven carving with seam-aware smoothing, riparian plugs, and ceiling clamps; keeps subterranean water aligned with rivers/basins.

server.name: river-lake-outflow-alignment
server.notes: Blend rivers into lake basins with flow accumulation carry-over; stitch hydrology envelopes across chunk seams.

client.name: terrain-preview-masks
client.notes: Preview renderer consumes shared mask metadata (hydrology/flow/river/lake) to display stitched terrain in editor/runtime.

server.name: data-driven-config-fingerprint
server.notes: JSON-backed config loader with checksum logging; feeds world map control generation and hydrology/lake/cave thresholds.

client.name: streaming-profile-hotload
client.notes: Hot-reloads map-control JSON and resets preview generator when hash/signature changes; ensures data-driven parameters stay synced.
